channel.title: Product Diary
channel.description: What changed across the projects, day by day.

item.title: OS Pi Fixes Monkey Island Speed, SnapDog Linux Tests
item.description: OS Pi's Monkey Island cutscenes ran at half speed because timed chores were skipped, while SnapDog's Linux test mode learned to freeze a Mac screen.

item.title: OS Pi Fixes Half-Speed Cutscenes in Monkey Island
item.description: OS Pi was running Monkey Island's cutscenes at about half speed, and I found the cause: timed background chores were being skipped.

item.title: SnapDog Linux Simulator Learns to Freeze a Mac Screen
item.description: SnapDog's Linux simulator on the Mac can now freeze the screen to pick a window or region, but I still have not seen it capture a real display.

item.title: AI Budget Build Goes Live With Mac, Linux and eGPU Advice
item.description: AI Budget Build, my parts-picker for running AI models at home, went public on Thursday and now covers Windows, Linux, Mac and external graphics cards.

item.title: Build Fleet Fixes a Job Denied After a Legitimate Retry
item.description: The build fleet no longer refuses a job that was retried while being copied to another Mac, and its checks passed on a second machine.

item.title: OS Pi Gets Wallpapers, Color Themes and Right-Click Menus
item.description: OS Pi, my classic-Mac-style desktop, now lets you choose a wallpaper and color theme that survive a restart, with context menus and list views for folders.

item.title: SnapDog Linux Fixes Window Shots That Captured Wallpaper
item.description: SnapDog's Linux version was saving pictures of the wallpaper instead of the window you picked, and the pickers now cover the whole screen.

item.title: AI Budget Build Gets a Parts Picker, Still Unpublished
item.description: AI Budget Build now lets you pick a machine and a budget and shows which graphics cards fit, what they cost and what they draw.

item.title: AI Budget Build Gets a Parts Picker, OS Pi Audio Stays Broken
item.description: AI Budget Build became a clickable graphics card picker, OS Pi spent a day measuring Monkey Island audio it still plays wrong, and SnapDog got studio checks.

item.title: OS Pi Classic Game Music Still Plays Each Note Twice
item.description: OS Pi ran Monkey Island with steady audio counters all day, but I still hear the opening music doubled, so the sound problem is not fixed.

item.title: SnapDog Studio Learns to Wait for the Simulator to Boot
item.description: SnapDog's reel-making studio can now wait for a phone simulator to start and open web links in it, and warns about badly sized app previews.

item.title: SnapDog Linux Rebuild, Pipe Flow's Sea, a Blank TV Library
item.description: A freshness check caught stale SnapDog Linux installers, Pipe Flow got a reactive sea, and a Hisense sign-in fix blanked my podcasts library.

item.title: Hisense Podcasts Sign-in Fix Blanked the Library Screen
item.description: A fix for a misdrawn password box on my television's podcasts app blanked the library after sign-in, until I narrowed the fix.

item.title: Night Chorus Gets Liquid Slag and a Button Shape Test
item.description: Night Chorus, the crystal puzzle game once called Prism Shift, gained a flowing drowned-slag look and a test that catches lopsided menu buttons.

item.title: Pipe Flow Gets a Living Sea That Reacts to Your Moves
item.description: Pipe Flow's first world now has a living sea of turtles, kelp and coral that reacts as you play, on phone, Mac and television.

item.title: SnapDog Linux Packages Rebuilt After a Stale-Code Check Failed
item.description: SnapDog's Linux installers were out of date after the Loom import work, so I rebuilt all three as version 0.2.59 and fixed a Loom link edge case.

item.title: AdGenerator Panel Reopens Projects and Plays the Real Ad
item.description: AdGenerator's control panel can now reopen saved projects, play the real ad inside a project page with zoom, and draft a voice line or stills.

item.title: Dead Signal Gets a Reader Page and Tracking on the Books Site
item.description: The Dead Signal pages on my books site got a proper reader page for the first chapter, tracking of visitors, and a corrected address.

item.title: Build Fleet Stops Crying Wolf About Builds Marked Local
item.description: The build fleet's alarm for builds that skipped it no longer fires on builds I declared local, and it now names wrapped builds correctly.

item.title: Hisense Podcasts, SnapDog Loom Import, Night Chorus Worlds
item.description: A lost Apple sign-in exposed three hidden faults in my Hisense podcasts app, while SnapDog learned Loom imports and Night Chorus got 15 living worlds.

item.title: Hisense Podcasts App Fixes Tabs, OK Key and Empty Shelves
item.description: The podcasts app on my television had three faults that only showed on a cold start: unreachable tabs, a dead OK button, and empty shelves.

item.title: Night Chorus Gets Living Backgrounds for All 15 Chapters
item.description: Night Chorus, the crystal puzzle game formerly called Prism Shift, gained animated worlds and hazards for its 15 chapters in a Mac prototype.

item.title: SnapDog Learns to Import Loom Videos on Mac and Linux
item.description: SnapDog can now bring in a Loom video, from a share link or a downloaded file, on the Mac, on Linux and in its reel-making studio.

item.title: Build Fleet Learns to Watch AI Coding Sessions on Every Mac
item.description: The Build Fleet now tracks which AI coding tools are running on each computer, and a renamed Mac that quietly refused jobs is fixed.

item.title: StatBar Shows What Grew While SnapDog Photographs Itself
item.description: StatBar shipped three releases that show which folders ate the disk, the Hisense podcasts app got an Apple TV look, and SnapDog's tutorial found bugs.

item.title: Hisense Podcasts App Gets an Apple TV Look and a Sound Stall
item.description: The Hisense television's podcasts app got a new Apple-style home screen and shelves, then a stall in the sound that the new artwork had caused.

item.title: SnapDog Tutorial Recording Exposes a Menu Leak, Stale Editor
item.description: Recording a SnapDog tutorial caught region captures that included the app's own menu, and an editor that kept showing the previous image.

item.title: StatBar Ships Three Releases and Shows What Ate Your Disk
item.description: StatBar went from 1.7 to 1.10 in one day and can now show which folders grew most, how many days remain until the disk fills, and scan faster.

item.title: Hermes Fleet Still Cannot Find the Laptop and NAS Memory Dips
item.description: My house assistant's morning report failed again, one laptop is still unreachable, and the NAS has less spare memory than at any earlier check.

item.title: Grok Bot Notes Find No Bot Changes and Flag Two Quiet Repos
item.description: The notes on my fleet of assistants found no changes to any bot on Friday, and the morning scan noticed two projects of mine had moved overnight.

item.title: Epochs of Power Research Lands as SnapDog Gets a Slide
item.description: A paperwork day: my Epochs of Power game research was saved to git, SnapDog got a one-slide story, and Lectern's ads were corrected.

item.title: Epochs of Power Records Where the Old Game Decides Ties
item.description: My strategy-game research gained a long set of written findings about Call to Power II, plus scripts that watch the original game run.

item.title: Grok Bot Notes Record a Quiet Day and a Mac Mini Back Online
item.description: The notes on my fleet of assistants recorded no changes to any bot, and noted that the Mac mini reconnected after a day offline.

item.title: Hermes Fleet Misses the Same Laptop for a Sixth Morning
item.description: My house assistant's overnight head-count again could not find one laptop, and my NAS now has less spare memory than at any earlier check.

item.title: Lectern Gets Ad Copy That Matches What the Store Sells
item.description: The Mac app itself did not change; I wrote new ad copy after finding my own notes undersold what the store version already does.

item.title: SnapDog Gets a One-Slide Story of Its Road to the Store
item.description: The app itself was unchanged, but I added a one-slide summary of how it went from idea to the Mac App Store.

item.title: Dead Signal's Book Page Gets Tracking and a New Sample Address
item.description: The Dead Signal pages on my books site now report where visitors came from, and the opening sample has moved to a new address.

item.title: Dead Signal Gets Ad Tracking as SnapDog Notes Get Fixed
item.description: Dead Signal's book pages learned to track where ad visitors come from, and my own SnapDog notes turned out to be wrong about its release.

item.title: Hermes Fleet Misses the Same Laptop for a Fifth Morning
item.description: My house assistant's overnight head-count again could not reach one laptop, and the spare memory on my NAS fell to its lowest figure so far.

item.title: Remnant Academy Gets a Tax Switch and a Payment Fix
item.description: The academy's checkout can now collect sales tax once I switch it on, and a payment-recording check that could hide failures was tightened.

item.title: SnapDog Gets New Ad Research After Its Own Notes Were Wrong
item.description: The app did not change, but I wrote new ad copy for SnapDog after finding my own notes still called the shipped app unreleased.

item.title: SnapDog Gets a First Demo Film as Hermes Fleet Fails
item.description: SnapDog, my Mac screenshot app, now has a two-minute silent demo film for its website, while my house assistant failed its morning check again.

item.title: Grok Bot Notes Record Eleven Assistants Renamed in a Day
item.description: The notes on my fleet of assistants noted that eleven bots were renamed with a new title style, and that no new bots appeared.

item.title: Hermes Fleet Fails Its Morning Check for a Fourth Day
item.description: My house assistant's morning health report failed again and its head-count still cannot reach one laptop, but the other three machines answered normally.

item.title: SnapDog Gets a First Silent Film Cut for Its Website
item.description: The first complete demo film for SnapDog's website exists as a silent two-minute story, and the notes say plainly which features it does not yet prove.

item.title: Hermes Fleet Misses a Laptop as Grok Bot Adds Two Bots
item.description: A quiet Monday: SnapDog's old proof files went into version control, Hermes Fleet lost a laptop again, and Grok Bot's notes caught up.

item.title: Grok Bot Documents Two New Assistants After a Missed Week
item.description: The house notes for my fleet of assistants caught up after five days without a refresh and added two new bots, one for election mail and one for phone calls.

item.title: Hermes Fleet Recounts the House and Still Misses a Laptop
item.description: My house assistant's overnight head-count still cannot reach one laptop, and its morning health report failed again because the model server stayed silent.

item.title: SnapDog Files Its Scrolling-Capture Proof and Two Decks
item.description: The app did not change; I filed the proof that scrolling capture works, my demo-film shoot notes and two slide decks telling its story.

item.title: Hermes WebUI Went Live and the Fleet Lost Its Voice
item.description: My house assistant put a web front-end on my private network in eight minutes, while its morning health report failed and its evening voice crashed.
